name: Texas AFT (Texas American Federation of Teachers)
lean_basis: Not rated: a union that says it is “a statewide union with 66,000 members, including K-12 and community college educators, support staff, and retirees” (https://www.texasaft.org/about). Its own words name no political side, and no outside rating was found.
